name: CLEARBOX

steps.title: Stick the feet under the base
steps.detail: Turn the base board over and press a foot into each corner.

steps.title: Bolt the corner posts to the base
steps.detail: Turn the base back over. Each post stands on a corner, the slot facing in.

steps.title: Slide in the back panel
steps.detail: Peel the film off both faces first. It drops into the slots of the back posts.

steps.title: Slide in the side panels
steps.detail: Same as the back: down the slots until they rest on the base.

steps.title: Lay the top panel on and tighten
steps.detail: Hold it level while the bolts go in, then tighten all eight post bolts.

steps.title: Hang the front door
steps.detail: The hinges go on the left post. Keep the gap at the top even.

steps.title: Fit the door handle
steps.detail: From the outside, with the screws through from the inside.

tips.general: Acrylic scratches easily: keep the protective film on until each panel goes in, and wipe with a damp cloth only.

watchOut: Leave a gap of at least 5 cm behind the enclosure for the printer's cable and the vent.
